displayName: Media Expert API - Black Week Prices, Omnibus Low, Store Stock
description: Media Expert API for Media Expert Black Week prices and store stock in Poland (mediaexpert.pl, PLN) - for any product, the price, the old (struck-through) price, the lowest price of the last 30 days that Media Expert shows next to a promotion (EU Omnibus Directive) and the code price with the discount code and its validity dates, plus Media Expert's stock indicator (a bucket such as 0, 2, 9 or 20, not a unit count) and the pickup-in-1-hour flag at the 40 Media Expert stores and pickup points nearest a Polish city, town or postcode. Keyword search, category, brand, outlet, promotion (Black Weeks) and marketplace-seller lists, 30 per page (up to 50), up to 100 pages, filtered by any facet; one product in full with specifications, variants, delivery labels and the seller (Media Expert or a marketplace seller with its rating); Media Expert's own reviews, up to 100 per page, with verified-purchase and promotional-campaign flags; every store with hours; the category tree, the brand directory and search suggestions. Data in Polish. 13 endpoints, 1 to 3 credits per call (actual cost). No Q&A, leaflets, price history, unit counts or checkout prices.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
